definition.prompt: Create a 4:5 photo-booth print with four photos in a 2-by-2 grid. Use a cobalt curtain, direct flash and subtle film grain. Preserve both reference identities. Reference image 1 is the person on the left; reference image 2 is the person on the right in every panel. Preserve their facial features, skin tones and hairstyles. Show relaxed smiles, exaggerated surprise, shared laughter and a playful shoulder lean, in reading order. Add a cream paper border with the readable caption "Better together" below the four photos. Keep both faces clear and fully inside every frame. No extra text, logos or watermarks.

review.notes: Four photos in a 2-by-2 grid on a 4:5 cream paper print. R1 remains left and R3 right in all panels; both faces recognizable with intact features, teal and burgundy tops. Smiling, surprise, laughter and shoulder lean occur in the requested sequence. Blue curtain, flash look, subtle grain, exact Better together caption with no other text.
